purpose: Describe a conspicuous appearance, sometimes a misleading one.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
さも … そうに / ように / げに
He nodded as though he knew all about it.
The cat closed its eyes looking thoroughly content.
She lowered her shoulders, looking deeply disappointed.
formation: さも … そうに / ように / げに
restrictions: Often suggests that someone acts as though something were true.
mistake: Whether the appearance is genuine comes from context.
